fields.summary_ko.0: Domestic securities firms have adjusted KOSPI targets downward by over 4,000 points from 10,000 in June to around 6,000 in November, following stock price movements.
fields.summary_ko.1: In February when KOSPI was rising, upward reports were 8.6 times more frequent than downward reports, but during the October 1-10 decline, downward reports (1,572 cases) were 3.8 times more frequent than upward reports (419 cases).
fields.summary_ko.2: The target price gap for SK Hynix between Morgan Stanley and Nomura Securities widened to nearly 3x, from KRW 1.6 million vs. KRW 4.7 million, intensifying divergence in broker forecasts.
